verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an inference cloud. A product like this could plausibly offer built-in AI insights, for example on a user's usage or account data, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows raw model APIs (OpenAI-compatible chat completions, embeddings, vision), which users must call from their own code. Nothing shows an in-product feature that analyzes the user's data and surfaces insights or suggestions.
